title: Audit the local evaluator model and advice equivalence
body:
Review Definition 2.1 and claim T01.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Check efficient universality and charged access costs.
- [ ] Check advice depends only on input length.
- [ ] Verify headers, constants, and finite exceptions.
- [ ] Record an actual independent human review.

References: paper/sections/02-model.tex; paper/sections/03-equivalence.tex.

title: Compare local description length with established KT conventions
body:
Derive explicit simulations in both directions without conflating KT, Kt, and K^t.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Specify machine and access models.
- [ ] Track input length versus table length.
- [ ] Account for input nodes and description headers in circuit size.
- [ ] Cite precise primary statements and label unresolved directions.

Start with docs/literature.md.

title: Investigate an order-robust lower bound in a specified restricted model
body:
The grouped-order example is easy under interleaving. Select a model and an explicit family for which a proposed bound survives the allowed representation choices.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Define allowed orders, encodings, and sharing.
- [ ] Give a complete proof or a precise counterexample.
- [ ] Separate the claim from general SAT circuit lower bounds.
- [ ] Add finite experiments only where informative.

title: Audit a possible transfer to the precise Gap-MCSP magnification theorem
body:
Determine whether a concrete local-description result can be connected to Oliveira-Pich-Santhanam Theorem 1.4.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] State reduction direction and source/target promises.
- [ ] Track N = 2^n and all resource overhead.
- [ ] Retain both thresholds and all parameter quantifiers.
- [ ] Document the missing reduction if none is established.

A restricted-model bound alone is insufficient.

title: Formalize the residual-function width lemma in a proof assistant
body:
Choose a proof assistant and formalize claim L02 before attempting a broader complexity development.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Define layered deterministic diagrams and residual functions.
- [ ] Prove distinct residuals require distinct states.
- [ ] Prove the residual construction attains each width.
- [ ] Match the formal theorem to manuscript conventions.
- [ ] Add a pinned and reproducible verification command.

title: Define publication scope, independent review, and licenses
body:
Prepare the decisions in PUBLICATION.md.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Identify the article contribution beyond the expository foundation.
- [ ] Complete a novelty and bibliography audit.
- [ ] Obtain independent mathematical review.
- [ ] Confirm authorship and AI-assistance disclosure.
- [ ] Select manuscript and code licenses.
- [ ] Select a venue before applying venue-specific formatting.
